source_text: Missus est ad me unus de Seraphim, et in manu eius carbo. Tetigit labia mea et abstulit iniquitates meas. Purgatus propheta paratus est ad ministerium. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: One of the Seraphim was sent to me, and in his hand a coal. He touched my lips and took away my iniquities. The cleansed prophet is ready for ministry. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[One of the Seraphim flew to me with a live coal >> Bible:Isaiah 6:6]]; [[it touched my mouth; your guilt is taken away >> Bible:Isaiah 6:7]]. Cleansed lips can preach. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
